question: Does the complete production-shaped AgentRun lifecycle satisfy issue 13 across load, real services, Cloud SQL, durability, and injected failures?

environment.sandbox: Docker Engine with pinned Alpine 3.22.1 digest
environment.worker-fleet: 256 lifecycle workers (32 admission, 224 execution: 100 basic, 15 child, 85 Temporal, 20 sandbox, 4 SMTP), 512 database connections, 128 Temporal gateway requests, 256 Temporal workflow slots, fixed for run

scenarios.name: temporal-timer-herd-retry-batch
scenarios.workload: real eight-step Temporal workflows with concurrent timers, approvals, sandbox artifacts, and injected first-attempt publish failures
scenarios.persistence_profile: cold logical reconstruction plus immutable artifact

scenarios.name: approval-gated-mailpit-batch
scenarios.workload: bounded non-workflow SendEmail ToolCalls to Mailpit

scenarios.name: e2b-focused-conformance
scenarios.workload: one no-internet E2B sandbox create, command, artifact hash, and teardown

scenarios.name: rig-openai-live-conformance
scenarios.workload: one bounded Rig request through the OpenAI Responses API
scenarios.persistence_profile: provider conformance only; PostgreSQL remains authoritative

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: Temporal retried and attempt 2 succeeded
failure_matrix.invariant: one terminal workflow outcome

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: client connection was discarded after commit, then the immutable receipt returned the same AgentRun
failure_matrix.invariant: one admission and one UserMessage

failure_matrix.injection: expired lease takeover and stale completion
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: replacement claimed epoch 2, epoch 1 completion was fenced, terminal reclaim was rejected
failure_matrix.invariant: stale attempts cannot commit and terminal runs cannot be claimed

failure_matrix.injection: artifact export verification and commit interruption
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: verified bytes were committed by stable ArtifactRef identity, the lost commit acknowledgement reconciled, and later object mutation was rejected
failure_matrix.invariant: only verified immutable bytes and an idempotent ArtifactRef commit become authority

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: concurrent cancellation and workflow delivery serialized to one terminal cancellation or one exact wake
failure_matrix.invariant: a canceled AgentRun never reactivates and a delivered outcome wakes at most once

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the worker rejected an unknown mandatory semantic record without mutating lifecycle state
failure_matrix.invariant: unsupported authority is explicit and cannot be silently skipped

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the first refused SMTP attempt entered retry-ready, the second exhausted the frozen bound, and the AgentRun failed once
failure_matrix.invariant: retry amplification is bounded and one terminal ToolCall outcome is authoritative

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: unfinished child canceled, duplicate expiry and late outcome reconciled
failure_matrix.invariant: one parent wake and canceled child remains terminal

failure_matrix.injection: ChildJoin concurrent settlement and late outcome
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: concurrent child transactions serialized, one parent wake committed, and late duplicate reconciled
failure_matrix.invariant: exactly one ChildJoin wake

failure_matrix.injection: partial model output before normalized outcome
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the partial fragment survived reconnect, immutable replay reconciled, mutation was rejected, and one normalized outcome committed
failure_matrix.invariant: committed fragments are replayable and the ModelCall has one outcome

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the committed ModelCall intent was retried after the connection was discarded and resolved by stable record identity
failure_matrix.invariant: provider dispatch has one authoritative intent

failure_matrix.injection: Osfo worker process kill and restart
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the claimed worker process was killed, its lease expired, and a replacement took epoch 2
failure_matrix.invariant: accepted work survives worker death and stale ownership is fenced

failure_matrix.injection: checkpoint absent, deleted, corrupt, and incompatible
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: cold reconstruction completed from PostgreSQL for absent and unusable optional checkpoint references
failure_matrix.invariant: RuntimeCheckpointRef is acceleration only and never lifecycle authority

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: both returned idempotent replay
failure_matrix.invariant: one ToolCall outcome and one Mailpit message

failure_matrix.injection: sandbox missing, deleted, corrupt, expired, and incompatible
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the provider resumed a valid stopped sandbox, returned missing for absent or deleted resources, and rejected corrupt, expired, incompatible, and mutable identities
failure_matrix.invariant: SandboxRef is optional acceleration and cannot silently select untrusted state

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: stable idempotent outcome returned
failure_matrix.invariant: one approval settlement

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: closed workflow rejected every update
failure_matrix.invariant: terminal history is immutable

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: validator rejected every update
failure_matrix.invariant: wrong gate cannot settle

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the stable workflow identity completed, a repeated start observed the existing closed execution, and PostgreSQL received one terminal outcome
failure_matrix.invariant: a lost start acknowledgement cannot create a second WorkflowInstance or a second wake

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: start failed while the AgentRun stayed waiting, then the same stable WorkflowInstance completed after service recovery
failure_matrix.invariant: PostgreSQL intent survives dependency outage and outcome wakes once

failure_matrix.injection: Temporal worker process kill and restart
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the polling worker process was killed during a real workflow and a replacement on the same task queue completed the persisted history
failure_matrix.invariant: Temporal history survives worker death and Activities remain retryable and idempotent

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: concurrent durable timers and delayed terminal callbacks drained
failure_matrix.invariant: every workflow completed once after the herd

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: an unknown external outcome was recorded, reconciled to one terminal outcome, and replay after a lost acknowledgement was idempotent
failure_matrix.invariant: unknown outcomes are explicit and terminal semantic outcomes are unique

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: an incompatible lane left accepted work pending until a compatible worker became available
failure_matrix.invariant: incompatible workers cannot consume or corrupt accepted work

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: the first acknowledgement was treated as dropped and the same callback identity was replayed
failure_matrix.invariant: PostgreSQL committed one delivery and one wake

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: cancellation before approval and during timer or Activity settled, while post-terminal cancellation could not change the result
failure_matrix.invariant: cancellation is durable and terminal history is immutable

failure_matrix.injection: duplicate workflow progress and outcome delivery
failure_matrix.observed_recovery: PostgreSQL reconciled duplicate typed progress and outcome deliveries
failure_matrix.invariant: progress committed once and parent woke exactly once for terminal outcome

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: nondeterminism detected for every history
failure_matrix.invariant: bad deployment is rejected

failure_matrix.observed_recovery: all histories replayed
failure_matrix.invariant: deterministic worker code
